title: Instant Ender Portal
description: This mod allows you to put all the eyes of ender in the portal frames in one click!
body:
This mod allows you to put all the eyes of ender in the portal frames in one click!

Ever felt that placing all 12 eyes of ender into the portal frame is annoying? Install this mod and simply click once!

How to use: Just right-click a portal frame (the frame has to be a part of a whole portal) to instantly place all twelve eyes of ender and open the portal to the End!
